mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT NVL(COUNT(*), 0) FROM USERS) AS "totalMemberCount", (SELECT NVL(COUNT(*), 0) FROM USERS WHERE TRUNC(createdDate) = TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AS "todayMemberCount", (SELECT NVL(COUNT(*), 0) FROM USERS WHERE TRUNC(createdDate) = TRUNC(SYSDATE - 1)) AS "yesterdayMemberCount", (SELECT NVL(SUM(CHARGEAMOUNT), 0) FROM PAYMENT WHERE PAYSTATUS = 'PAID' AND TRUNC(PAIDAT) = TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AS "todayRevenue", (SELECT NVL(SUM(CHARGEAMOUNT), 0) FROM PAYMENT WHERE PAYSTATUS = 'PAID' AND TRUNC(PAIDAT) = TRUNC(SYSDATE - 1)) AS "yesterdayRevenue", (SELECT NVL(COUNT(*), 0) FROM TRADETRANSACTION WHERE TRUNC(TRADEDATE) = TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AS "todayTradeCount", (SELECT NVL(COUNT(*), 0) FROM TRADETRANSACTION WHERE TRUNC(TRADEDATE) = TRUNC(SYSDATE - 1)) AS "yesterdayTradeCount", (SELECT NVL(COUNT(*), 0) FROM adminReport WHERE processStatus = 0) AS "pendingReportCount" FROM DUAL

SELECT TO_CHAR(d.dt, 'MM/DD') AS "label", NVL(( SELECT SUM(p.CHARGEAMOUNT) FROM PAYMENT p WHERE p.PAYSTATUS = 'PAID' AND TRUNC(p.PAIDAT) = d.dt ), 0) AS "amount" FROM ( SELECT TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 6 + LEVEL - 1 AS dt FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 7 ) d ORDER BY d.dt

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT 'MEMBER' AS "activityType", u.nickname AS "title", '님이 BATON에 가입했습니다' AS "description", 'ri-user-add-fill' AS "iconClass", 'bg-pink' AS "bgClass", TO_CHAR(u.createdDate, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "eventDate" FROM USERS u UNION ALL SELECT 'PAYMENT' AS "activityType", NVL(p.MERCHANTUID, '포인트 결제') AS "title", '결제가 완료되었습니다' AS "description", 'ri-coin-fill' AS "iconClass", 'bg-blue' AS "bgClass", TO_CHAR(p.PAIDAT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "eventDate" FROM PAYMENT p WHERE p.PAYSTATUS = 'PAID' UNION ALL SELECT 'REPORT' AS "activityType", '커뮤니티 신고' AS "title", '새 신고가 접수되었습니다' AS "description", 'ri-error-warning-fill' AS "iconClass", 'bg-orange' AS "bgClass", TO_CHAR(r.reportDate, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "eventDate" FROM adminReport r UNION ALL SELECT 'TRADE' AS "activityType", NVL(pr.title, '중고거래') AS "title", '거래가 생성되었습니다' AS "description", 'ri-shopping-bag-3-fill' AS "iconClass", 'bg-green' AS "bgClass", TO_CHAR(t.tradeDate, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "eventDate" FROM TRADETRANSACTION t LEFT JOIN PRODUCT pr ON pr.PRODUCTIDX = t.PRODUCTIDX ) ORDER BY "eventDate" DESC FETCH FIRST 8 ROWS ONLY

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT t.TRADEIDX AS "tradeIdx", NVL(p.TITLE, '상품명 없음') AS "productTitle", NVL(s.NICKNAME, '-') AS "sellerName", NVL(b.NICKNAME, '-') AS "buyerName", NVL(t.TRADEPRICE, 0) AS "tradePrice", t.TRADESTATUS AS "tradeStatus", TO_CHAR(t.TRADEDATE, 'MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "tradeDate", CASE WHEN t.TRADESTATUS IN ('SHIPPING', '배송중') THEN 'tag-blue' WHEN t.TRADESTATUS IN ('PAY_COMPLETED', 'CONFIRMED', '거래완료', 'COMPLETED') THEN 'tag-green' WHEN t.TRADESTATUS IN ('CANCELED', 'CANCELLED', '취소됨') THEN 'tag-red' ELSE 'tag-gray' END AS "statusClass", CASE WHEN p.CATEGORYIDX IS NOT NULL AND MOD(p.CATEGORYIDX, 5) = 0 THEN 'ri-headphone-line' WHEN p.CATEGORYIDX IS NOT NULL AND MOD(p.CATEGORYIDX, 5) = 1 THEN 'ri-smartphone-line' WHEN p.CATEGORYIDX IS NOT NULL AND MOD(p.CATEGORYIDX, 5) = 2 THEN 'ri-macbook-line' WHEN p.CATEGORYIDX IS NOT NULL AND MOD(p.CATEGORYIDX, 5) = 3 THEN 'ri-gamepad-line' ELSE 'ri-shopping-bag-3-line' END AS "productIcon" FROM TRADETRANSACTION t LEFT JOIN PRODUCT p ON p.PRODUCTIDX = t.PRODUCTIDX LEFT JOIN USERS s ON s.USERIDX = t.SELLERIDX LEFT JOIN USERS b ON b.USERIDX = t.BUYERIDX ORDER BY t.TRADEDATE DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 6
